title: AW28 Men's Trim Stories
summary: Trims that carry each AW28 menswear theme.
research_period: AW28/29 colour previews (October 2026), AW27 fairs (September 2026), SS28 previews

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. AW28 fabric fairs take place in September 2027 and the shows in early 2028. This report projects from the first AW28/29 colour forecasts, the AW27 fabric fairs, SS28 previews and long-term market and regulatory drivers. Forecut will update it as evidence arrives.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body: - AW27 forecasters expected familiar codes made personal, eveningwear in daywear and protected, light volume in menswear<sup>[1]</sup>
